v28-11.candidate: And the Lord your God shall multiply you in good things, in the offspring of your womb, and in the produce of your land, and in the offspring of your livestock, upon the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give you.

v28-13.candidate: The Lord your God make you the head, and not the tail; and you shall then be above, and not beneath, if you hearken unto the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you this day to keep and do.

v28-51.candidate: And it shall consume the offspring of your livestock and the produce of your land, leaving you neither grain, nor wine, nor oil, nor the herds of your cattle, nor the flocks of your sheep, until it destroys you.
